verdict.rationale: Fenwick has a dedicated 'artificial-intelligence-tools' page that describes concrete AI workflows: brief analysis that surfaces uncited relevant cases, and due-diligence contract extraction and summarization. Its Fenwick Labs page also describes in-house built tools such as automated incorporation documents and intelligent patent alerts, which goes beyond a passing marketing mention. However, the evidence shows no named tools, no published AI-use or governance policy, and no clear first-party AI product, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: named AI tools or vendors, a published AI usage/ethics policy, explicitly AI-powered proprietary products, independent corroboration.
